title: UI Animations & Advanced 🎞️
description: Animate widgets, use 3D widgets, and build a main menu.

slides.title: Animating UMG 🎬
slides.content:
# Bring It to Life

Widgets can be animated using the **Animations** panel (bottom of Designer):

1. Click **+ Animation** to create a new animation track.
2. In the timeline, set keyframes for widget properties (Position, Opacity, Scale, Color).
3. Call the animation from the Graph using **Play Animation** node.

Use animations for menu transitions, damage flashes, and button hover effects.

quizData.question: UMG animations can only change position, not colour.
quizData.explanation: You can animate almost any property: position, opacity, colour, scale, etc.

slides.title: 3D Widgets 🌍
slides.content:
## UI in the World

You can place widgets **in the 3D world**:

1. In a Blueprint, add a **Widget Component**.
2. Assign the **Widget Class** to your Widget Blueprint.
3. The component renders the widget on a plane in the world.
4. Set **Draw Size**, **Pivot**, and **Space** (World or Screen).

Useful for floating health bars, nameplates, interactive computer screens.

slides.title: Main Menu Setup 🏠
slides.content:
## Start Screen

To build a main menu:

1. Create a new level (e.g., `MainMenu`).
2. Design a Widget Blueprint `WBP_MainMenu` with buttons (Start, Quit).
3. In the Level Blueprint, on BeginPlay, Create Widget, Add to Viewport.
4. On **Start** click → use **Open Level** node to load the game level.
5. On **Quit** click → use **Quit Game** node.
6. In Project Settings → Maps & Modes, set the Game Default Map to your MainMenu level.

quizData.question: To switch from the main menu to the game level, use the _____ node.
quizData.explanation: The Open Level node loads a new map by name or reference.

slides.title: UI Sound & Polish 🎵
slides.content:
## Final Touches

* Attach **Sound Cues** to button hover/click events (in Style).
* Use **Tweeners** or **Material** transitions for background.
* Test with different screen resolutions (Simulate in toolbar).
* Ensure keyboard/gamepad navigation works.

A polished UI makes the game feel professional.

slides.title: Pro Tip 🚀
slides.content:
## Use Common UI Plugin

For advanced cross‑platform UI, enable the **Common UI** plugin. It provides reusable button styles, input modes, and navigation.
